_comment: The decision model's question (CONTRACT.md Player loop): read by body/src/player/client.js and scripts/player_eval.py, so the live loop and the offline tuning tool ask the same thing. {intent} is filled in.
instructions: Goal: {intent}. Pick the one action that makes progress toward it now. If no offered action can make progress, answer stuck. Answer done only when the goal is satisfied.
survive_instructions: Goal: stay alive while the running task goes on. Pick continue_task unless a threat or a hazard needs a reaction now.

descriptions.sprint: sprint forward, up to two blocks
descriptions.dig_ahead: break the block in front at feet/head height
descriptions.dig_above: break the block above the head
descriptions.dig_below: break the block under the feet and drop into its space
descriptions.place_below_and_jump: jump and place a block under the feet to climb one block
descriptions.place_ahead: place a block in front at feet height
descriptions.attack: hit the nearest hostile mob in reach
descriptions.retreat: step away from the nearest threat
descriptions.extinguish: put out the fire: step into water, or wait it out
descriptions.stuck: no offered action can make progress toward the goal
descriptions.continue_task: let the running task carry on
